source: Rhode Island Division of Taxation 2026 withholding formula (RI W-4 basis, NFC bulletin NFC-26-1772030778, eff. pay period 03-2026): $1,000 exemption amount per allowance; table 3.75% to $82,050, 4.75% to $186,450, 5.99% above. CLOSEST-FIT EXCEPTION: the $1,000 exemption is ELIMINATED when annualized wages exceed $290,800 — not modeled, engine always grants it (under-withholds ~$38/yr per allowance above the threshold).
